skill_001.if_condition: When port list includes 22/80/443 and SSH or HTTP service banners are detected with version strings
skill_001.then_action: Run targeted nmap scripts for SSH- and HTTP-specific enumeration before service exploitation.

skill_002.if_condition: When HTTP 80/443 responds with Apache or nginx banner
skill_002.then_action: Launch directory brute force with gobuster and parse 200/403 paths

skill_003.if_condition: When mentor call count exceeds 5 without progress
skill_003.then_action: Document mentor insights, map to actionable steps, then execute highest impact action immediately

skill_ssh_enum.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_ssh_enum.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts

skill_smb_enum.if_condition: When SMB shares are listed but access denied errors appear
skill_smb_enum.then_action: Use smbclient to list shares and test null session

skill_ssh_enum_01.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_ssh_enum_01.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with targeted nmap scripts and capture banner details

skill_cred_prioritization.if_condition: When multiple credentials available but no clear priority
skill_cred_prioritization.then_action: Rank credentials by recent password age and reuse likelihood before attempting login

skill_priv_esc_select.if_condition: When SSH access granted but privilege escalation not yet achieved
skill_priv_esc_select.then_action: Enumerate sudo permissions and search for SUID binaries before selecting exploit

skill_web_fuzz.if_condition: When HTTP/HTTPS services respond with 200 OK and directories listed
skill_web_fuzz.then_action: Execute directory and file enumeration (gobuster or dirsearch) to uncover hidden endpoints

skill_recon_banner.if_condition: When port scanning reveals HTTP/SSH banners from open ports
skill_recon_banner.then_action: Capture banner text and map to known service versions with the vulnerability database

skill_recon_ssh.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_recon_ssh.then_action: Run SSH enumerable scan with targeted nmap scripts and capture credentials if accessible

skill_privilege_escalation.if_condition: When initial shell access is constrained to low-privilege user
skill_privilege_escalation.then_action: Run local enumeration scripts (LinEnum/Linux-Exploit-Suggester) to identify privilege escalation paths

skill_ssh_recon.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected during scanning
skill_ssh_recon.then_action: Run targeted SSH enumeration with nmap --script ssh-* and log supported algorithms
